title: Copperfield ClearFlow Launch Strategy
brief: A launch strategy for Copperfield’s countertop water filter, drafted from the company’s objectives, market research, and unit economics.

slip.document:
# Copperfield ClearFlow Launch Strategy
Strategy review | 02/18/2026 | Prepared for Lucas Moreau, Andre Bishop, and Fatima Tran

## Objective and market
Copperfield's goal is to sell 4,000 ClearFlow countertop filters in the first 90 days while keeping paid-media customer acquisition cost (CAC) below $32. Research of 600 U.S. households found that 58% of renters want a filter that installs without tools; the leading competitor requires faucet installation. Position ClearFlow around tool-free setup and a replaceable cartridge subscription, without making unverified water-safety claims.

## Unit economics
| Item | Amount |
| --- | ---: |
| MSRP | $79 |
| Landed product cost | $28 |
| Fulfillment and payment fees | $11 |
| Gross contribution before marketing | $40 |

Keep the planned 90-day offer at 10% off MSRP; at $79, the discounted price is $63.10. Use the $79 MSRP to protect margin and fund introductory advertising.

## Channel evidence and allocation
| Channel | Test spend | Purchases | CAC |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Paid search | $6,000 | 240 | $25 |
| Paid social | $6,000 | 150 | $40 |

The CAC target is met by paid search but missed by paid social. Paid social is the only channel meeting the CAC target. Review CAC and conversion rate weekly; pause any placement that remains above $32 CAC after two weeks.

## Creator pilot
Contract three home-organization creators for short-form setup demonstrations. Provide each creator a filter and a $500 fee. This is the complete posting brief: show the tool-free setup and link to Copperfield's product page. No other creator posting instructions will be issued. Track views, clicks, and purchases using unique landing pages; assess the pilot after 30 days.

## Measurement
Andre Bishop owns weekly reporting; Fatima Tran approves creative and Lucas Moreau approves budget changes. Compare the 4,000-unit objective with orders at day 30, 60, and 90.

errors.explanation: A 10% discount on the stated $79 MSRP is $7.90, making the discounted price $71.10. The quoted price is an arithmetic error.

errors.quote: Paid social is the only channel meeting the CAC target.
errors.explanation: The channel table shows paid search CAC of $25, below the $32 target, and paid social CAC of $40, above it. The sentence contradicts the preceding evidence and reverses which channel meets the target.
errors.fix: Paid search is the only channel meeting the CAC target.

errors.quote: This is the complete posting brief: show the tool-free setup and link to Copperfield's product page.
errors.explanation: Creators receive a product and a $500 fee, which are material connections that must be clearly and conspicuously disclosed in endorsements under FTC guidance. The complete brief contains no instruction to disclose either connection.
errors.fix: This is the complete posting brief: clearly disclose that Copperfield provided a filter and paid a fee, show the tool-free setup, and link to Copperfield's product page.
